hero.subtitle: Full Stack Developer, and more
hero.tagline: 5 years of experience · Angular - Java · Three.js

about.bio:
I build software that runs on critical systems. Five years in defense and aerospace — Naval Group, Airbus, DGA — on real-time tactical simulation platforms and operational 3D visualization interfaces.
On the business side: Java Spring Boot, Angular, microservices architecture, constrained environments and high reliability requirements. On the rendering side: Three.js, WebGL, and Unreal Engine on personal projects — because the boundary between critical applications and interactive visualization has always interested me.
Based in Paris. Available for VIE or international assignments.

carrier.title: GesVol – Aircraft carrier flight management
carrier.description: From-scratch development of a flight management system for the aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle (Angular 18, Java 17 Spring Boot 3). Tech Lead role: full stack architecture design, infrastructure deployment on RKE2 (Kubernetes on Linux), code reviews and team mentoring. Linux environment administration and production deployment.

rafale.title: SimTac – Real-time tactical simulation mapping
rafale.description: Development of a web-based tactical simulation platform with real-time 2D mapping visualization for the French Defense Procurement Agency (DGA). Integration of a 3D video stream generated by Unreal Engine rendered directly in the browser. Java Spring Boot REST API development and Angular interfaces for real-time operational data display.

submarine.title: Combat system network recording module
submarine.description: Development of a real-time network data recording and visualization module during the end-of-studies internship. Combat system network frame capture and analysis, data stream visualization interfaces, unit test implementation, and Angular 5 → 12 version migration.

helicopter.title: RETEX – Onboard equipment design tracking
helicopter.description: Enhancement of an onboard equipment design tracking application for Airbus. Development of new Angular 15 frontend and Java Spring Boot 3 backend features, maintenance and support of existing functionality, participation in client demonstrations and Scrum ceremonies.

lighthouse.title: Mine countermeasures & maritime alerts
lighthouse.description: Development of an Angular web application for drone mission planning in mine countermeasure operations. Migration of a maritime alert management application from a heavy C# client to a modern Angular web interface. Design of interactive mapping UI components, in close collaboration with business teams and end users.

fregate.title: RFID – Onboard equipment tracking
fregate.description: Design and development of an application for tracking and locating onboard equipment via RFID. Development of a multirecord RFID tag encoding module in C#, Node.js backend APIs in a microservices architecture, and Angular frontend interfaces integrated with RFID services. Unit testing and functional acceptance testing.
